info.name: Insights.Api Balancing Mechanism Dynamic Bid-Offer API

params.name: from
params.description: The "from" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: to
params.description: The "to" start time or settlement date for the filter.

params.name: settlementPeriodFrom
params.description: The "from" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: settlementPeriodTo
params.description: The "to" settlement period for the filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides the bid-offer data for a requested BMU. It returns the data valid over a given time
range, excluding any results where LevelFrom and LevelTo are both zero.
            
By default, the from and to parameters filter the data inclusively and this endpoint will return any data that
overlaps even at a single instant. If the settlementPeriodFrom or settlementPeriodTo parameters are provided, it
will instead filter to return any data that overlaps with the specified range of set

params.name: settlementPeriod
params.description: The settlement period to filter. This should be an integer from 1-50 inclusive.

params.name: bmUnit
params.description: The BM Units to query. Elexon or NGC BMU IDs can be used. If omitted, results for all BM units will be returned.

params.name: format
params.description: Response data format. Use json/xml to include metadata.

items.docs:
This endpoint provides market-wide bid-offer data, for all BMUs or a requested set of multiple BMUs.
It returns the data valid for a given settlement period, excluding any results where LevelFrom and LevelTo are both zero.
            
The settlement period to query must be specified as a date and settlement period. The date should be provided in the format yyyy-MM-dd.
